final_recommendation.configuration: 15x Sales Hub Professional seats + Marketing Hub Professional (<=2k marketing contacts) + ~25 free core seats (creatives/passive users, read-only)
final_recommendation.data_residency: EU (Frankfurt) selected at portal creation - irreversible, verify before any data import
final_recommendation.fallback_vendor: Zoho CRM Enterprise (if budget cap drops below ~EUR 30k)
final_recommendation.eliminated: Salesforce - licences ~EUR 79k/yr plus EUR 15-50k implementation, roughly 2x the cap before training; requires admin capacity Brightline lacks

rollout_plan.name: Foundation & pipeline core
actions: Create portal with EU (Frankfurt) data hosting; verify region before any data import
Sign DPA with SCC fallback; complete transfer impact assessment; flag non-marketing contacts from day one
Appoint two champions (senior AM + media buyer) with weekly 30-min office hours for 8 weeks
Migrate live clients and last 12 months of history only; onboard 12 AMs via HubSpot Academy (2-6 hrs/person)
Set three non-negotiable behaviours modelled by leadership: every interaction logged, pipeline updated weekly, no side spreadsheets

rollout_plan.name: Media buyers & ad-ops integration
actions: Connect Meta/Google/LinkedIn ad accounts via native Ads tool; enable lead-form capture and ad-attributed revenue reporting
Add GA4 connector; assess DSP middleware needs from EUR 2,000 reserve
Onboard 8 media buyers; week-4 adoption checkpoint (weekly active users, % deals updated in last 7 days)

rollout_plan.name: Read-only rollout & adoption verification
actions: Creatives get free-seat read-only access; no mandatory workflows
Week-8 gate: <70% AM weekly-active triggers intervention before phase completes
Stand up quarterly full-data export to Brightline-controlled storage (exit hedge); week-12 review of adoption metrics and contact-tier consumption vs 3-year cost model

executive_summary: All three specialists independently recommended HubSpot at confidence 4/5: only platform with genuinely native Meta/Google/LinkedIn ads sync and ad-attributed revenue reporting; shallowest learning curve with free role-based training and no admin headcount; best overall risk balance with EU hosting and moderate lock-in. Recommended configuration (15 Sales Hub Pro seats, Marketing Hub Pro, 25 free read-only seats, EU Frankfurt residency) costs an estimated EUR 34,300 year-1 (EUR 37,700 with 10% contingency), inside the EUR 40,000 CEO cap. Salesforce eliminated as over-scaled (~2x cap before training, deepest adoption dip, needs an admin the agency lacks); Zoho retained as budget fallback (~EUR 24k/yr) but rejected as primary because higher training cost, integration assembly, and weakest support erode most of its price advantage.

reconciliation.vendor_choice: Unanimous - all three specialists recommended HubSpot (each 4/5 confidence); no override needed.
reconciliation.cost_vs_budget_cap: Market researcher's HubSpot range (EUR 30-48k/yr) breached the EUR 40k cap at the upper end. Resolved by fixing the seat mix to 15 paid Sales Pro seats + Marketing Pro entry tier + 25 free seats, directly applying customer-discovery's finding that creatives should be read-only and out of mandatory workflows. Contact-tier cost-creep risk (risk analyst, severity 3) mitigated via non-marketing contact flagging and annual tier negotiation in Phase 1.
reconciliation.gdpr_weighting: Risk analyst rates Salesforce's GDPR posture strongest (residual risk low) vs HubSpot low-medium. Weighed below cost and adoption because the gap is closable with the analyst's own mitigations (EU Frankfurt at portal creation, written TIA, SCC fallback) and Salesforce's compliance edge is moot when its licence cost alone is double the total budget and adoption is likely to stall - a control nobody uses protects nothing.
reconciliation.zoho_value_case: Zoho saves ~EUR 10k/yr on licences but loses most of it to higher training (EUR 5-12k vs 2-5k), middleware assembly for Meta/GA4, and weakest support with shadow-spreadsheet risk, while accepting medium compliance residual risk. Kept as formal fallback only.

market_researcher.hubspot_adops_fit: best native; built-in Ads tool syncs Meta/Google/LinkedIn ads, lead-form capture, ad-attributed revenue reporting; GA4 via standard connectors; DSPs need middleware
market_researcher.key_tradeoff: Salesforce = depth at 2-3x cost and high admin burden; Zoho = lowest cost but weaker ecosystem and shallower integrations; HubSpot = best adoption + only truly native ad-platform integration at mid-pack TCO

customer_discovery.learning_curve_hubspot: Shallow: 3-7 days to working competence, 2-3 weeks to fluency; free HubSpot Academy role-based training; agency staff often pre-exposed via client work
customer_discovery.role_mix_assumed: ~12 account managers, ~8 media buyers, ~14 creatives, ~6 ops/leadership
customer_discovery.adoption_gate: <70% AM weekly-active at week 8 triggers intervention

risk_analyst.gdpr_posture_hubspot: EU data hosting (Frankfurt) selectable only at portal creation; relies on EU-US Data Privacy Framework for US subprocessors; good DPA and consent tooling. Residual risk: low-medium.
risk_analyst.gdpr_posture_salesforce: Strongest formal posture but residency guarantees may require specific editions/add-ons. Residual risk: low.
risk_analyst.gdpr_posture_zoho: EU DCs (Amsterdam, Dublin) but weaker compliance documentation and subprocessor transparency. Residual risk: medium.
risk_analyst.lock_in_hubspot: Medium: good CSV/API exports but workflows/reports/assets do not port; annual prepay; exit 4-8 weeks.
top_hubspot_risks: Portal created in US region by default; EU residency cannot be switched later (severity 4)
Cost creep from marketing-contact tiers and Hub bundling at renewal (severity 3)
Schrems II transfer exposure if DPF invalidated (severity 3)
risk_analyst.exit_hedge: Quarterly full data export to Brightline-controlled storage; document key workflows outside the tool
